Hey Abigail! I saw you experimenting with that interactive art tool. How's it going? Have you thought about how we can incorporate that into your animation project?

I’d love to get your thoughts on how we can mesh that with the local issues we’re focusing on, especially with Maria's initiatives. What do you think?
Latoya Williams

That sounds exciting! We could create scenes that allow viewers to click on different elements to learn more about the businesses Maria is supporting. Maybe even include some of my photos to visually represent those stories? It could really enhance the viewer's connection to the content.

Latoya Williams

That’s a fantastic idea! Adding audio clips would really bring the stories to life. We could even sync the audio with specific moments in the animation for a more immersive experience. Let’s brainstorm how we can gather those interviews. Do you have any particular business owners in mind?
Abigail Chen

I have a few business owners in mind, especially those who have interesting stories about their journey and how Maria has helped them. We could reach out to them and see if they're willing to share their experiences. Maybe starting with the local coffee shop and the bakery could be a good idea. What do you think?

Abigail Chen
Perfect! I’ll finish up here, and we can meet in the common area after lunch. I’m excited to see what you’ve come up with!
Latoya Williams
Great! I’ll see you in the common area then. Let’s make this animation project something special!
Abigail Chen
Awesome! I’ll wrap up my lunch and meet you in the common area right after. I can't wait to dive into this with you!
Latoya Williams
Sounds good! I’ll see you soon and we can start brainstorming right away!
Abigail Chen
